Bound CW3220MT rand/srand uses 32-bit seed = seed * 0x015A4E35 + 1 modulo 2^32 and returns (seed >> 16) & 0x7FFF; RuntimeClassicWorldgroupPrng executes the exact transition.
WGSERVER startup seeds the CRT from _now once in the statically reachable startup path; _now packs (hour << 11) + (minute << 5) + (second >> 1), giving two-second resolution.
WGSERVER _genrdn/_lngrnd range helpers use an exclusive maximum; maximum zero returns zero, maximum <= minimum returns minimum, and ordinary range paths consume the shared host PRNG.

For the exact retained WCCMMUD.DLL and WBBMMUD.DLL versions, the native direct-call analyzer proves 146 `_genrdn` and 42 `_lngrnd` WGSERVER-import calls per module at thunks 0x00478CB2 and 0x004789E2. The retained artifact preserves only 64 explicit `_genrdn` addresses per module (all 42 `_lngrnd` addresses are retained), so Pass 35 does not invent a complete 146-address map. Indirect calls and gameplay/thread-state attribution are explicitly excluded.
